root: How LLMs Learn to Be Useful

children.label: Initial Process
Model consumes vast corpora: web text, books, code, conversations.
Primary task is to predict the next token in the sequence.
Relies on brute-force statistical learning of language patterns.
Early Capabilities
Model achieves fluent sentence completion abilities.
Lacks instruction following, harm refusal, or task adherence.
Supervised Method
Engineers collect curated examples of desired conversations.
Supervised training is conducted on thousands or millions of examples.
Behavioral Shift
Model learns to mimic specific tone, format, and structural elements.
Transforms the model into a chatbot-like experience.
Feedback Loop
Humans rank multiple model responses to a single prompt.
A reward model is trained to predict these human rankings.
The language model is then optimized to maximize the predicted reward.
Outcomes & Challenges
Makes the model helpful, honest, and harmless in practical use.
Introduces failure modes like sycophancy and mode collapse.
Can lead to over-refusal, which researchers are actively debugging.
Runtime Operation
Model weights are frozen; tokens sampled one at a time.
Sampling occurs from the model's predicted token distribution.
Behavioral Control
Decoding parameters (temperature, top-p) manage creativity and randomness.
The system prompt effectively steers the model's behavior.
Tool use, retrieval, and agents operate on top of the frozen model.
